title: Cartridge blueprint
description: Everything needed to BUILD a cartridge, and nothing that has to be downloaded to do so: identity, a descriptor template, pinned sources, a pinned toolchain, targets, and the ordered steps that turn sources into the artifacts of a pack_dir (blueprints.adoc, SKEEP-007, ADR-015). A blueprint carries no weights, no compiled model and no runtime binary.

spec_version.description: The cartridge-spec version this blueprint conforms to.

id.description: Stable identity, OQ3 naming without the target: <task>-<model>-<runtime>. The id of a materialized cartridge is `<id>-<target id>` unless the target sets `cartridge_id`.

version.description: Version of the blueprint (recipe + code), semver. Independent of the version of any cartridge materialized from it.

license.description: License of the blueprint's OWN content — code, recipe, docs. SPDX. This is NOT the effective license of a materialized cartridge, which is computed at materialization from the licenses of the sources and inputs actually used (ADR-004).

descriptor_template.description: A capability descriptor with the materialization-resolved fields left out. Template + resolved fields MUST validate against cartridge-descriptor.schema.json. The fields named in `propertyNames.not` are resolved by the materializer and MUST NOT appear here: identity and version come from the profile, `target` from the chosen target, `license` is computed, and `performance` / `quality` are MEASURED on the materialized artifacts — a blueprint cannot know them.

sources.description: What materialization downloads. Every source is pinned by an immutable revision AND by the sha256 of every file taken from it.

toolchain.description: Every tool a step names, pinned to an exact version. Keys are the names steps refer to in `tool`.

targets.description: The targets this blueprint knows how to materialize for. A cartridge is built for exactly one of them.

flavors.description: Optional. Variants one materialization can bundle as descriptor `flavors` (ADR-014) — typically a language: which sources belong to the variant and which descriptor fields it overrides.

sources.description: Names of the `sources` this flavor needs.

descriptor_overrides.description: Descriptor fields this flavor replaces in full (ADR-014: no deep merge), e.g. `attributes` and `model`.

inputs.description: Materialization inputs: things the blueprint needs but deliberately does not contain, supplied by the materialization profile — a tool catalog, a calibration set, a vocabulary. Declaring them keeps host- or organization-specific content out of the blueprint.

role.description: The manifest artifact role the input takes in the materialized cartridge.

schema.description: Path (relative to the blueprint) or URL of a JSON Schema the supplied input MUST validate against.

steps.description: The recipe, in execution order. A step reads sources, inputs or earlier steps' products (`uses`) and yields named products (`produces`).

outputs.description: How step products become the manifest artifacts of the materialized pack_dir (ADR-012).

verification.description: Checks a materialization MUST pass before it is packed and signed. Source digests are always verified and need no entry here.

kind.description: 'parity' = compiled/quantized output vs. float reference within `tolerance` (index.adoc, Developing, 5a); 'golden' = fixed input → expected output shipped with the blueprint; 'task-metric' = task quality on a pinned evaluation set (5c); 'conformance' = ctg-conform (OQ5).

on_device.description: true when the check needs the real target hardware.

reference_measurements.description: Optional. What the blueprint's authors measured, per target, stated as an EXPECTATION for whoever materializes. Never copied into a descriptor: a materialized cartridge reports only what was measured on its own artifacts.

name.description: What steps and outputs refer to.

uri.description: Where the publisher serves it. `hf://<org>/<repo>` for a model hub repository, otherwise an https URL. A profile MAY substitute a mirror; the digests below do not change.

revision.description: Immutable revision at the publisher: a commit id for repositories, a release identifier otherwise. A branch name or `main` is not a revision.

license.description: License of the source as published — SPDX where possible, otherwise a marker (`community-restricted`, `proprietary`) or the license's name.

redistribution.description: 'allowed' = the license permits redistributing the file or works derived from it; 'restricted' = it does not, or only under conditions a materializer must check (revenue cap, display duty, field of use); 'acceptance-required' = the publisher makes access conditional on accepting terms — materialization MUST refuse to fetch until the profile records that acceptance.

version.description: Exact version. Ranges are not pins.

coordinates.description: Where the tool comes from when it is a library or plugin.

image.description: Container image when the tool runs in one; SHOULD include a digest.

cartridge_id.description: Id of the cartridge materialized for this target, when `<blueprint id>-<target id>` is not wanted.

requirements.description: Descriptor `requirements` that hold for every cartridge built for this target.

params.description: Target-specific parameters steps may read (compiler backend, GPU architecture, dtype).

kind.description: 'fetch' downloads and digest-verifies sources; 'convert' changes format or layout without changing numerics beyond dtype casts; 'quantize' changes numeric precision; 'export' turns a model into a compiler input (e.g. StableHLO); 'compile' turns that into a target artifact; 'build-runtime' builds the native runtime library; 'measure' produces performance/quality on the target; 'pack' assembles the pack_dir; 'sign' signs the manifest.

uses.description: Names of sources, inputs, or products of earlier steps.

per_target.description: true when the step's products differ per target (compile, build-runtime, measure).

path.description: Path inside the pack_dir; by convention under `artifacts/<role>/` (ADR-012).

derived_from.description: Names of the sources and inputs this artifact descends from — what the manifest's `derived_from` and the license computation are built from. Empty only for artifacts built purely from the blueprint's own code.

flavor.description: Set when the artifact exists only for one flavor.
